subject: Operating Systems
description: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to operating system concepts, including process management, memory management, file systems, and device handling. It emphasizes how an OS acts as a resource manager and enables user interaction with hardware.
objectives: Understand the role and functions of operating systems as resource managers.
Explain the concepts of process, thread, and scheduling algorithms.
Describe mechanisms for synchronization, deadlock handling, and interprocess communication.
Understand memory management techniques including paging and segmentation.
Analyze the structure of file systems and input/output management.
course_outcomes: Explain the fundamental concepts, services, and architecture of operating systems.
Describe process management and scheduling algorithms for CPU allocation.
Apply synchronization and deadlock avoidance techniques in concurrent systems.
Understand and implement memory management schemes.
Illustrate file system organization and input/output operations.

modules.title: Introduction to Operating Systems
topics: Types of Operating Systems – Batch, Time-Sharing, Distributed, Real-Time, and Embedded

modules.title: Process Management
topics: Processes – Concept, States, and Process Control Block
Process Scheduling and Types of Schedulers
Process Synchronization: Race Conditions and Critical Section Problems

modules.title: CPU Scheduling and Deadlocks
topics: CPU Scheduling Criteria and Algorithms (FCFS, SJF, Priority, Round Robin, Multilevel Queue)
Methods for Handling Deadlocks: Prevention, Avoidance, Detection, and Recovery

modules.title: Memory Management
topics: Memory Management Strategies – Contiguous and Non-Contiguous Allocation
Paging, Segmentation, and Virtual Memory Concepts
Allocation of Frames and Demand Paging

modules.title: File Systems and I/O Management
topics: File Concept, Access Methods, Directory Structure
File System Implementation – Allocation Methods, Free-Space Management

suggested_books: Abraham Silberschatz, Peter Baer Galvin, Greg Gagne, Operating System Concepts, 10th Edition, Wiley
Andrew S. Tanenbaum and Herbert Bos, Modern Operating Systems, 4th Edition, Pearson
reference_books: William Stallings, Operating Systems: Internals and Design Principles, 8th Edition, Pearson
D.M. Dhamdhere, Operating Systems: A Concept-Based Approach, Tata McGraw-Hill
